# EduScale

> Free learning platform for engineering students: public career roadmaps with per-topic quizzes, coding challenges in an in-browser editor with a sandboxed code runner, and real-time quiz battles with matchmaking and leaderboards. One free tier; nothing is behind a paywall.

EduScale is a side project by Shailesh Chaudhari (Software Engineer at ContextQA, Ahmedabad, India). Author portfolio: https://shaileshchaudhari.vercel.app.

## Live

- App: https://eduscale.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/Shailesh93602/DevScale

## Why this exists

Real-time quiz battles look simple: two players, one question set, shared state. The hard part is keeping that state correct under concurrency when battles run across several Node processes. EduScale's backend uses `@socket.io/redis-adapter` so Socket.io events reach players on any process, Redlock distributed locks around the battle start, answer and completion transitions (each transition is also a compare-and-set, so a lapsed lock cannot double-apply it), opossum circuit breakers around the code-execution sandbox and the AI calls, prom-client metrics, and Bull queues for background work (email delivery with a dead-letter queue, audit-log retention).

## Tech stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Redux Toolkit
- **Backend**: Node.js + Express.js (TypeScript), Prisma ORM + PostgreSQL, Socket.io with @socket.io/redis-adapter, redlock, opossum, prom-client, Bull queues
- **Infrastructure**: Redis (Socket.io adapter, locks, cache), Supabase Auth, Vercel hosting
